ctx.x: Professor, right? All right, Professor Ira Gitler, there are some names that -- some musicians that -- some of them, most of them are dead -- that should have been included in this creative period of music labeled jazz, and I'd like to name some of them -- Bill Coleman, Benny Morton, Mary Lou Williams -- she's had acclaim, but not as much as Marian McPartland. She's a creator.
